interactions.description: These medicines significantly increase internal bleeding risks.
interactions.recommendation: Consult doctor immediately before combining blood thinners.

interactions.description: Ibuprofen may reduce Aspirin's cardioprotective effect and increase stomach irritation.
interactions.recommendation: Use with caution under medical supervision.

interactions.description: May cause enhanced drowsiness and dizziness when taken simultaneously.
interactions.recommendation: Avoid operating heavy machinery or driving after taking both.
Generally safe when taken as directed.

interactions.description: Combining NSAIDs like Aceclofenac with blood thinners significantly increases gastrointestinal and systemic bleeding risks.
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination unless strictly monitored by your physician.

interactions.description: Concurrent use increases the risk of serious gastrointestinal ulceration and reduces cardioprotective efficacy.
interactions.recommendation: Consult a healthcare professional before taking together.

interactions.description: Dual angiotensin receptor blockade increases risk of severe hypotension, syncope, hyperkalemia, and renal impairment.
interactions.recommendation: Do not combine ARBs with Sacubitril/Valsartan.
